title: Follow multiple Dexcom G6s?
symptom: The user has three children each wearing a Dexcom G6, each with their own Android device collecting data via XDrip+ and uploading to individual Nightscout sites. The user wants to know if there is a way to use XDrip+ to follow all three data feeds simultaneously on their Android phone.
fix: The thread suggests using one of the xDrip variants to follow multiple Dexcom G6s, and also mentions using AppCloner to clone the APK and install it as a follower. The user also mentions using Dexcom Follow as an alternative.
evidence_quote: I would suggest using one of the xDrip variants. This is what we do here. Pro-tip change the flair colors to something different so you can tell them apart on your phone!
